description: Curated BMS split for SOC clamping vs DTC reporting.

REQ-BMS-022: SOC_Clamp() shall ensure the final SOC estimate is clamped to the range [SOC_MIN = 5.0 %, SOC_MAX = 95.0 %] before writing to PP_SOCPercent.
DTC_BMS_SOC_LIMIT shall be set when the raw SOC estimate exceeds 95.0 % or falls below 5.0 % for more than 10 consecutive cycles.
